entities.name: Frans Wilhelm Lindqvist
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frans Wilhelm Lindqvist was a Swedish inventor. He designed the first sootless kerosene stove, operated by compressed air. He started a company, Primus, to manufacture and sell the Primus stove.
